alternatives.A_briefTokens: This file's light + dark themes. Light default, full dark mode. See design-tokens.md for the verified/failed pairs.

B_v1Evolution.note: Dark #0c2030 header, paper gradient, teal #075f70, modernised (reader chrome, tokens, mobile drawer/strip, dark/light polish). Teal #075f70 verified: 6.97:1 on canvas, 7.29:1 on white (AA pass). Paper-gradient stops: UNVERIFIED — exact stops were not recovered from the reference prototypes in this pass and must be sampled from the live V1 CSS at implementation time, not guessed here. Continuity argument: this is the identity the owner already uses; redesign argument: the briefs call V1 a redesign-from, not a tweak, so an evolution must still read as a deliberate step forward.

C_editorialPaper.note: Serif-forward, quiet chrome, best long-form reading feel. Weakest for interactive/Explorer surfaces, which would need a companion component style. Its reading qualities (paper canvas, serif long-form, generous leading, quiet chrome) are adopted INTO Alternative A's foundation in this package's direction; its full palette is not adopted as the theme.
C_editorialPaper.verified: Ink on paper 12.25:1 (AA pass), accent on paper 6.03:1 (AA pass), muted on paper 4.77:1 (AA pass) — all computed from the editorial prototype's own CSS values.

referenceDarkBlueprint.note: Recorded as evidence that the dark prototype language already passes AA; it is not a fourth alternative, it is the dark half of the prototype pair.
referenceDarkBlueprint.verified: Ink on bg 16.94:1, muted on bg 9.05:1, accent on bg 11.27:1 (AA pass) — computed from the blueprint prototype's own CSS values.

usage_restrictions.accentTeal: Dark-theme teal text/icon colour. Do NOT pair white text with the light-theme #0D9488 in dark mode (3.74:1, AA fail); dark buttons use dark text #0F172A on #2DD4BF (9.59:1).
usage_restrictions.surfaceRaised: Verified as a text background: ink #E2E8F0 on #273449 = 10.18:1, muted #94A3B8 on #273449 = 4.89:1 (AA pass).
usage_restrictions.surfaceText: Verified on dark surface #1E293B: ink #E2E8F0 = 11.87:1, muted #94A3B8 = 5.71:1, blue #60A5FA = 5.75:1, teal #2DD4BF = 7.86:1 (AA pass).

usage_restrictions.accentBlueHover: VERIFIED: white on #1D4ED8 = 6.70:1 (AA pass, button label); #1D4ED8 on canvas #F8FAFC = 6.41:1 (AA pass, text).
usage_restrictions.accentTeal: LARGE TEXT (>= 18.66px bold or >= 24px), decorative elements, borders and icons ONLY. It FAILS AA for normal text (3.58:1 on canvas, 3.74:1 on white) and white text on it also fails (3.74:1). Never use #0D9488 for body text, links, or button labels.
usage_restrictions.accentTealText: Use this, not #0D9488, for teal body text and links (5.23:1 on canvas, AA pass).
usage_restrictions.provenanceAddedInk: VERIFIED: #175D9C on its panel bg #EDF5FF = 6.20:1 and on canvas #F8FAFC = 6.51:1 (AA pass).
usage_restrictions.provenanceBorders: Provenance border accents (#C28D3E original, #C18D35 verify, #42A987 diagram) are BORDERS ONLY: as text they fail AA (2.8:1, 2.66:1, 2.62:1 respectively). Never use them for text; panel text uses ink/muted/accent tokens.
usage_restrictions.surfaceRaised: Verified as a text background: ink #1E293B on #F1F5F9 = 13.35:1, muted #475569 on #F1F5F9 = 6.92:1 (AA pass).

diagram.rule: Diagrams are static SVG/Mermaid-style visuals or lazy-loaded interactive modules; never force every article into a canvas.

focus.rule: Focus must be visible in both themes; do not remove outlines without a replacement of equal visibility.
focus.style: 2px solid focusRing outline, visible on keyboard focus

nav.header: sticky, top 0, canvas background, 1px bottom border

diagram.label: Diagram (created, not a recreation of an original drawing)

provenancePanel.rule: Every panel that is not original material carries its label. Original scans are reproduced unchanged; enhancements, corrections and unverified claims are always labelled separately. No panel may present added material as original.

domainColours.note: No per-domain colour is assigned in this package. Domain is a grouping/filter, and inventing seven domain colours now would create a legend nobody approved. If domain colours are wanted, they must be proposed, contrast-checked, and approved as a separate decision.

layout.mobileBehaviour: Below 800px the sidebar becomes a horizontal strip (prototype behaviour: nav becomes a horizontal scroll strip, main padding narrows). A drawer is an acceptable implementation of the same behaviour, but the strip is the proven pattern.
layout.sidebarWidthNote: 240px is the width proven in all three reference prototypes (sticky sidebar switcher). The brief plan's 260-280px collapsible range is recorded as an open implementation option, not adopted silently; the owner can move this token without touching page code.

meta.contrast_method: WCAG 2.2 relative-luminance ratios, computed 2026-10-27 from the hex values in this file. AA normal text requires >= 4.5:1; AA large text / UI components require >= 3:1. Any token pair not listed in design-tokens.md under 'Verified contrast pairs' is UNVERIFIED and must not be used for body text until checked.
meta.direction: Alternative A foundation (brief tokens) WITH Alternative C long-form reading qualities. See design-tokens.md for Alternatives B and C.
meta.intended_feel: A serious research publication combined with an interactive engineering laboratory — not a generic blog, course marketplace, or documentation template. (Direction only; no copy is taken from any brief.)
meta.name: Aravind Systems Atlas — Batch 1 design tokens (framework-agnostic)
meta.source_of_truth: Content stays JSON (no MDX migration). Tokens are presentation only; they change no chapter content, slug, or URL.
meta.status: PROPOSED. Final theme remains the owner's call; no theme is declared final here.

shadow.card: none (border-defined cards, per the prototypes: 1px border, no drop shadow)
shadow.note: Shadows are intentionally absent in the prototype language; if a later implementation adds elevation shadows, they must be added as tokens here first, not hard-coded in pages.

typography.articleMeasureNote: Within the brief's 720-800px article range; the lower end is chosen so long-form lines stay readable on laptop widths with the sidebar present. Long-form article text uses fontLongform; UI, cards, nav and labels use fontUi; code and diagram labels use fontCode.
typography.fontNote: Stacks are named, not bundled, in this package. Implementation must self-host any non-system font locally in the repo (never hotlink) or fall back down the stack. Font files are NOT included here.
